source_window.resource_title: GOV.UK Public data guidance — open/restricted dataset access matrix
source_window.license: Open Government Licence v3.0 for the guidance page; underlying datasets are subject to the access/licence classifications stated on the page.

field_evidence.page_currency: HM Land Registry's official Public data guidance is marked Updated 1 May 2026 and applies to England and Wales.
field_evidence.open_data_classification: The page lists INSPIRE Index Polygons among datasets available for use and reuse under the Open Government Licence.
field_evidence.restricted_data_classification: The page lists the National Polygon Service under data available for use and reuse under chargeable, restricted licences.
field_evidence.title_number_semantics: The page states that a title number is HM Land Registry's reference given to an individual piece of registered land and that the title is an up-to-date record of legal ownership.
field_evidence.target_result_limit: This public/no-login policy page does not return a Forge Cottage title number, registered-title record, title plan, parcel polygon, geometry or bbox.
field_evidence.parcel_promotion_rule: No dataset access classification or title-number definition is promoted to a canonical parcel. Target-specific title/parcel binding and any spatial join/materialization remain local OpenCode or authorised HM Land Registry work.

first_missing_criterion: Verified BUILDING_PRESENT canonical parcel geometry/bbox for this producer. HM Land Registry's unused, updated Public data window confirms that INSPIRE Index Polygons are available under the Open Government Licence, while the National Polygon Service is chargeable/restricted, and it defines a title number as HM Land Registry's reference to an individual piece of registered land. The public/no-login page exposes no target-specific Forge Cottage title number, registered-title record, title plan, parcel polygon or bbox. Local OpenCode or authorised HM Land Registry access must bind the exact target title/parcel geometry and canonical bbox; after that, bind one unused exact official DEM/LIDAR tile or metadata-index record to that bbox.
exact_blocker: After the sustained zero-accept streak, the method was materially changed from a geospatial catalogue publication-status row to HM Land Registry's current portfolio-level public-data access/licensing matrix and title-number semantics. The official page confirms which relevant spatial products are open versus restricted, but it contains no target Forge Cottage record or machine-readable parcel geometry. Under the public/no-login constraint, this window cannot supply the canonical target parcel. No canonical parcel ID, geometry or bbox is asserted; spatial join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
